beats.say: How can Apple and Nvidia build world-class chips without owning a factory?
In 1987, Morris Chang founded TSMC to manufacture chips other companies design. Designers focus on design; the foundry focuses on making them.
That split made the industry remarkably efficient. It also concentrated the most advanced manufacturing in very few places, mostly Taiwan.
What does a foundry do in the chip business?

data.question: What does a foundry do in the chip business?
data.answer: It manufactures chips that other companies design.
